responsibility: Implements struct/union-specific aggregate semantics and TypeInfo preparation logic. It requests extra semantic work needed for struct TypeInfo generation, searches struct hooks such as `toString`, computes finalized struct layout properties including zero-initialization and lowered argument types, fits constructor/initializer expressions to fields, classifies POD-ness recursively, and supplies the concrete behavior of `StructDeclaration` and `UnionDeclaration` beyond the common aggregate base.
